pages.text: Stores twenty stacks of upgrades, up to 64 per slot, including normally unstackable JDT upgrades. Ordinary items and nested bags are rejected.

Right-click the held bag to open it. Shift-click transfers upgrades using legal player inventory stacks. The open bag is protected against pickup and hotbar/offhand swaps. Hold Shift over its tooltip to inspect the contents. Forge item-handler integrations access the same saved inventory.

Adds a 6x6 case and a machine menu side panel. Left-click installs one card; Shift-left installs the maximum. Right-click takes one card; Shift-right withdraws a legal stack. Carry upgrades to deposit them. Cases are found in either hand, inventory and configured Curios slots.
